verdict.rationale: Notion's first-party developer docs say connections can subscribe to real-time events such as page updates, property changes and new comments via webhooks. When a page or database changes, Notion sends a secure HTTP POST to your endpoint, and there is a dedicated webhooks reference page. Missing for 10: detailed docs on event types, payload schemas, signature verification and retry behaviour, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that webhooks work as described.
